report.summary: Chunk 5/5 of gated_writes.py: final loop building result dicts for gated write candidates; governance and policy holding logic.
risks: line 1121-1125 | medium | write_assignments and write_gates derived from tasks but tasks not defined in this chunk; if tasks list is empty or indices out of range, IndexError occurs. | Check that tasks list is non-empty and write_idx are valid indices.

line 1126-1131 | medium | gate_candidates call uses scheduler.project, avail, ledger_path, cancel, write_gates, artifact_dir; any of these could be None or cause runtime error. | Verify all arguments are properly initialized.
line 1133 | low | promotion_allowed, gov_state, gov_verdict from _governance_verdict; if project is None, error. | Ensure scheduler.project is not None.

line 1141-1150 | low | held list built under else branch assumes all candidates are held with same reason; if write_gates contain gates, this may be incorrect. | Confirm that gated writes are always held by policy when promotion_allowed is True.

line 1157-1179 | medium | Loop iterates over write_idx and candidates; uses assignment.paths, res.artifact.changed_paths, etc. If any attribute missing, AttributeError. | Ensure all result objects have expected attributes.

line 1180-1186 | medium | When res.ok is False or res.artifact is None, result status is 'write_gate_failed'; but gate failure may have been caught earlier; this else branch may be unreachable. | Review logic to ensure this branch is reachable.

line 1188-1196 | medium | If res.artifact_path is falsy, status 'gated_artifact_lost'; else 'gated_held'. But held_by_task may not have entry for task_id, leading to fallback reason. | Ensure held_by_task covers all candidates.
line 1198 | low | Return type annotation ignored; actual return may not match expected type. | Add proper type cast or fix return type.

claims.text: Clean candidate, not (yet) submitted for promotion: held by policy or by governance -- see `held_by_task` for exactly which.

claims.text: Else: status 'gated_held' with reason from held_by_task or fallback.

The loop uses 'tasks' to get gates, but 'tasks' may be out of scope or modified.
